_comment: THE CONTRACT. Extracted from invariants/orbit.md on 2026-09-27, which stated every tolerance in prose and enforced none of them. The engine reads this file; the MODEL NEVER SEES IT. If the model can read a tolerance it can rationalise an exception to it.

_applies_to.all: every enabled client in the live roster
_applies_to.global: runs once per run, not per client
_applies_to.has_leadform_source: client's conversion source is the Meta leadform writer
_applies_to.has_calendly_source: client's conversion source is the Calendly writer
_applies_to.has_platform_routed_truth: client whose conversion truth differs per ad platform (OBB)
_applies_to._rule: Capability-derived from the LIVE ads_clients_config, never a hardcoded client list. Three disagreeing hardcoded rosters (SKILL.md said 7, andy-read.mjs said a different 8, live config had 9) are what this field exists to make impossible.

_skip_rule: A skip MUST carry a reason from the closed list above. An unexplained skip is a VERIFICATION FAILURE, not a pass. This is what makes a 3-of-9-client report structurally impossible.

platform_truth_routing._comment: Zander's call, 2026-09-27: Hyros for Facebook, Neon/Orbit for Whop.

Clicks: Meta Graph vs Neon rollup
checks.gotcha: Neon's column is NAMED `clicks` but HOLDS inline_link_clicks. Comparing against Meta's `clicks` is a guaranteed false positive. See api/ads/audit.ts:88-95.

checks.title: Derived CPC / CPM / CTR
checks.tolerance_why: CTR is +/-0.1pp ABSOLUTE, not +/-5% relative: small click counts magnify the percentage into noise.

checks.title: Paid lead count equality (counted-UNION) vs walked GHL
checks.tolerance_why: Hard equality. Counted-UNION semantics MUST be applied to BOTH sides before comparing.
checks.known_false_positive: The GHL walker builds its window in UTC (_ghl-direct.ts:165-166) while Neon uses tz-aware clientWindow(). Documented low-magnitude drift class and a built-in false-positive source at window edges.

checks.title: Golden rule: no contact-age columns in window filters
checks.tolerance_why: The north star is last_paid_opt_in_at in window. Contact age is irrelevant; filtering on it silently drops re-opt-ins.

checks.title: Re-opt-in survives: old contact, new paid opt-in, still counted
checks.detail: A contact with dateAdded < window_start but last_paid_opt_in_at inside the window MUST appear in Neon.

checks.title: Opt-in dated by the event, not the sync clock
checks.detail: A now()-stamp (|opt_in - synced_at| < 2s) must corroborate a real event timestamp (fbc click time or dateUpdated) on the same NY calendar day.

checks.title: Rung-2 stamps need fresh-event corroboration
checks.detail: WARN when the parseable fbc click time is >7d older than the rung-2 (dateUpdated) stamp, or absent, AND the contact is not already a paid lead by first touch. Phantom re-opt-in via workflow touch; the class B5 structurally cannot see.
checks.known_false_positive: The shipped detector regex used `\d` inside a JS string, where the backslash is silently dropped, so it over-reported any rung-2 stamp with a non-null fbc (2026-06-19).
checks.structural_false_positive: FIXED 2026-09-28 by the precondition above. Without a first-touch guard this check CANNOT produce a true positive: paid is first-OR-last, so a contact with a Facebook first touch is a paid lead whatever its rung-2 stamp says, and the rung-2 staleness is cosmetic. Measured on 2026-09-28 across every candidate ever recorded (81 live + 30 archived): 111 of 111 carried a Facebook first-touch UTM. The check ran for 111 days and produced 111 false positives and zero true positives. It also generated the 60 rows of the illegal `aged_out_of_detector_window` status, because a finding that is not real has no legal resolution. Never re-enable per-item queueing without this precondition.
checks.recheck_note: MUST be recheckable WITHOUT the rolling 14-day window filter the live detector carries, or findings age out unanswerable - which is exactly why the illegal `aged_out_of_detector_window` status was invented.

excluded_campaigns._rule: The drill-down DELIBERATELY omits non-lead-gen campaigns: Hammer Them / Blitz by name, and (from Orbit PR #587, 2026-09-28) ANY campaign whose objective is in AWARENESS_OBJECTIVES. Their SPEND still counts in the headline KPI. So drill-down spend is EXPECTED to be lower than the KPI by exactly the excluded campaigns' spend.
excluded_campaigns.how_to_compare: Subtract excluded-campaign spend from the KPI before comparing, or compare against the endpoint's own excluded bucket. Comparing the raw KPI against the drill-down sum reports a permanent false gap that GROWS as more awareness campaigns are excluded.

checks.scale_warning: DEMOTED to count-only 2026-09-28 (Zander's call). 222 of 381 ledger entries were this check. The drain path named in resolution_source has never been used: on 2026-09-28, ads_ghl_contacts.review_status was NULL on all 12,163 rows and reviewed_at was NULL on all of them. The Booked Calls review screen (api/ads/contacts/review.ts, BookedCallsView, AllContactsView) ships and works; nobody opens it. A queue whose only exit is unused can only grow, and it was a large part of why every report said ACTION. If per-item queueing is ever restored, it must be gated on somebody actually working the screen.
checks.judgment_note: Verdicts must be read back from review_status, never decided by Andy. While the count-only demotion stands there is no verdict to make.

checks.detail: The set diff is deterministic. Judging whether the volume is plausible (e.g. 40 exclusions in one day with no operator session) is not.
checks.judgment_note: WARN on implausible volume or a golden-rule-violating stamp. SILENT otherwise: a normal day's diff is a changelog, not a finding.
checks.structural_false_positive: MUT-1 appeared in 71 of 71 reports from its introduction to 2026-09-28, always as a narrated changelog ("MUT +3 OBB excl 330"), because nothing enforced the judgment_note above and the model reported the diff rather than applying the gate. The contract was correct and unenforced. warn_if makes it executable: below the trailing-p95 and above no golden-rule violation, this check PASSES SILENTLY.
